pass.claim: alpha=(7+sqrt(13))/6 and 3*alpha^2-7*alpha+3=0; homological gap has explicit 1/O(n) lower bound
Reflection R in O(2)\SO(2) fixes Gamma=VV^T but sends Omega=V J2 V^T to -Omega; no signed wedge observable can be a Gamma-only function.

Physical equal-mass planar Jacobi x=(3/10,0), u=(0,3/2), X=(8,0), W=(3,-27/640), b=41/100,V=2: total angular momentum L=.5(x wedge u)+(2/3)(X wedge W)=0; all five strict X10 margins positive; reflection (x2,X2,u2,W2) -> negative gives exactly same Gram Gamma and opposite signed binary ell_infinity. Thus a Gamma-only deterministic signed-flip predictor is impossible.
At equal-mass Euler E+ normalized x=(sqrt2,0),X=0,u=nu_E*x,W=0: 8D Jacobian eigenvalues match {0,nu_E,-nu_E/2,-2nu_E,(nu_E/4)(A-1),-(nu_E/4)(A+1),(nu_E/4)(-1±iB)} up to finite-difference tolerance.

Using angular momentum c itself as an analytic transverse coordinate (dc !=0), exact c'=-nu*c/2 implies every additive resonance term Theta*Sigma in the c-equation is zero. Remaining resonances/mixed fibre effects are not thereby eliminated.

issues.reason: nu_L=-sqrt(6) at L_minus cannot be the Euler expanding scale. Equal masses have U_E=5/sqrt(2), nu_E=+sqrt(5*sqrt(2)); Euler eigenvalue multiplier is nu_E/4 in McGehee tau, and the published (A-1,-A-1,-1±iB) expression is in normalized Euler time. Re-derive signs/chart labels from DF(E_plus). Beta_E and omega are eigenvalue ratios, unaffected by common positive time scale. Moreover using nu_L/4<0 as a 'lower bound' makes the stated E+ Diophantine inequality vacuous; replace it with nu_E/4>0 before invoking Siegel.

Diophantine homological gaps are analytically given; analytic conjugacy and its radius require exact Siegel theorem hypotheses, local vector-field analytic charts and validated domain; not a globally explicit chart.
Pure inequalities presented; n1,nR,n2, epsilon_M, k2, 141 chart coverings and validated Lohner code still unaudited; new-radius cover is RUN 48/141, old-radius 141/141 must not be substituted.

A nonzero numerical coupling is not an interval exclusion of zero; the asymptotic scattering observable may fail to extend C1 to the exact Euler orbit. Establish extension on a specified collision-free outgoing branch.
For unequal masses {1,a,b} rational independence is a separate mass-dependent hypothesis; at sigma* an explicit quadratic resonance occurs.
